infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: PlantScan AI requires camera access to capture photographs of plant leaves, stems, and fruits for disease identification.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: PlantScan AI requires photo library access to upload leaf photos for pathology analysis.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow PlantScan AI to access your camera to diagnose crop diseases.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow PlantScan AI to access your photo gallery to select crop images.
